Title: Public Preview: Application Gateway for Containers - AKS managed add-on

Body.Content:
We're announcing public preview of an AKS managed add-on that simplifies the deployment and lifecycle management of Application Gateway for Containers and its ALB Controller. With the managed AKS add-on, you can enable Application Gateway for Containers with a single command for new or existing AKS clusters through Azure CLI, ARM, and Bicep. 

The managed add-on helps streamline operations by providing: 

  • Managed installation and updates of the ALB Controller (so you don't need to maintain Helm charts) 

  • Secure integration via managed identity with least-privilege permissions 

  • Simplified networking when using AKS managed virtual network configuration 

The add-on also integrates with AKS' managed Gateway API add-on for seamless management of Gateway API CRDs within your AKS cluster. 

Learn more: 

  • Deploy Application Gateway for Containers + AKS Add-on  

  • Application Gateway for Containers overview
